title: RWB-S7-E6021-APP: the plan holds no C or X row for the four consumed contracts of the pack-prepared step, no dependency row for DP-05, no interface for the ALS and general-ledger crossing, and no separate story for the shared pack rule R-WO-05
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R7.3 and R9; split plan slices RWB-S7-E6021-APP, RWB-S7-E6021-CON and RWB-ITG-E6021-ITG; context pack S7 rwb-writeoff (service row, ownership rows, Architecture v5 slides 3, 4, 5, 8 and 13, Temporal and Drools slides 5, 12 and 13); legacy RWB-E6-021; FSD S7 Write-off and recovery v3 A2.9, A2.3 and A1.4; TSD S7 Write-off and recovery v2 T2, T3.0, T3.1, T3.3, T4, T5.1, T5.2, T6.1 and T-A; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-WO-05, R-WO-20 to R-WO-25 and R-WO-44; Event and Messaging Design v4 EV-24; Batch and Scheduling Design v4 JOB-16; Recovery Workbench Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 row FEAT-WOF-09
description: (1) The plan gives H = RWB-S7-E6021-CON, RWB-PLT-E1027-CON and RWB-PLT-N001-CON with C, I and X empty, while the step reads the rwb-source-data account, asset and ledger facts, the rwb-case state and move and the rwb-decision package, so four consumed rows have no plan row and are class C in fact. (2) DP-05 is in the pattern set and adds no dependency by the table, yet in this service it closes the own-ACE-view option because S7 holds no recovery.v_ace_* grant, so the rwb-source-data contract becomes a dependency of the build with no metadata row. (3) The plan gives legacy AC1 and AC3 to RWB-ITG-E6021-ITG, so the ALS and general-ledger crossing, the posting reference, the rejection and the re-post (R-WO-20 to R-WO-23, R-WO-44) and the provision release (R-WO-25) sit outside this story, yet TSD S7 T5.1 publishes no external interface at all and no source gives the ALS or GL field list, file layout, reference shape or error set, so no element can be declared. (4) FSD S7 A2.9.3.1 and A2.3.3.1 list the same R-WO-05 row, and RWB-S7-E6015-APP already builds the pack under it, so a second builder in this story would duplicate a rule and a table state; no source says which story owns the row. (5) The two operations of the legacy Endpoints table are the scan (API-S7-001) and the committee decision (API-S7-002), which belong to RWB-S7-E6013-APP and RWB-S7-E6018-APP to -E6020-APP, so this feature provides no operation and the stage read behind SCR-27 has no published name. (6) The plan's reqs row is empty although REQ-S7-002 and REQ-S7-005 in the FSD cover the feature, and the TSD T8 rows map every REQ-S7 row to FEAT-WOF-01. (7) DP-09 is absent from the pattern set although the service owns topic rwb.writeoff.events.v1 and EV-24, so the outbox and inbox library RWB-PLT-TE006-CON has no H row.
evidence: Split plan slice RWB-S7-E6021-APP (H three rows, C/I/X empty, patterns DP03, DP05, DP13, DP19, acs AC2 and AC4, reqs empty); TSD S7 T5.1 (None) and T5.2 (published module interfaces, no operation names); FSD S7 A2.9.3.1 (VR-S7-009-1, R-WO-05, R-WO-23, R-WO-44) and A2.3.3.1 (R-WO-05); Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 R-WO-05 and R-WO-20 to R-WO-25; context pack connection-matrix row S7 (T to P7, T E to P8, R E to P1, empty to P3) and ownership rows (write_off, two POST operations, EV-24, JOB-16, WriteOffWorkflow); legacy RWB-E6-021 Endpoints, Data and Test cases
owner_role: Solution architect with the rwb-writeoff tech lead, the rwb-source-data, rwb-case and rwb-decision owners and the wave 4 integration lead
proposed: Record the four consumed rows as class C in the Dependency Map without changing the plan's H row, treat DP-05 as consumed on rwb-source-data's contract, keep the ALS and GL crossing, the re-post and the provision release with RWB-ITG-E6021-ITG and declare no element for them, read R-WO-05 in this story as the assertion of the pack RWB-S7-E6015-APP builds, and add REQ-S7-002 and REQ-S7-005 to the traceability of both stories at D1.

title: RWB-S7-E6021-CON: the consumed operation names, the ACE and ledger shapes, the unprinted state values, the prepared-posting-pack element and the ALS and general-ledger interface have no published baseline
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R7.2 and R9; split plan slice RWB-S7-E6021-CON; context pack S7 rwb-writeoff; legacy RWB-E6-021; FSD S7 Write-off and recovery v3 A2.9.2, A2.9.3.1, A2.9.3.3 and Screens; TSD S7 Write-off and recovery v2 T2, T3.0, T3.1, T3.3, T4, T5.1, T5.2, T6.1, T7 and T-A.1; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-WO-05 and R-WO-20 to R-WO-25; Recovery Workbench API Specification v4 /write-off-scans and /write-offs/{writeOffId}/committee-decision; Logical Data Model and Data Dictionary v8 (DF-ACE, DF-INT, DF-FIN)
description: (1) No source publishes a REST operation that reads the account and asset facts, reads the interaction ledger, moves a case state on behalf of a stage or reads the WO rule package, so four consumed rows carry placeholders and the baseline cannot name them. (2) TSD S7 T4 prints 25 of the 51 rule rows under a 27-state machine, so the POSTING values beyond PACK_PREPARED, POSTING_PENDING, POSTED, POSTING_REJECTED, WRITEOFF_EXCEPTION and PROVISION_RELEASED have no printed value. (3) write_off.decision_log_id names the P7 decision_log_entry while DP-03 keeps a local record, so the baseline must state which identifier the column carries. (4) The prepared pack the posting track consumes has no published element: the pack rows live in the FSD field catalog and in the pack story, and no schema names the five facts the baseline declares. (5) TSD S7 T5.1 gives the external system interfaces as None, so the ALS and general-ledger crossing the feature names has no field list, no file layout, no reference shape and no error set. (6) TSD S7 T-A.2 gives the error set as status codes with no message id per condition, so each condition is bound to a legacy message by the story and not by the source. (7) The stage read behind SCR-27 is unpublished, so the baseline declares an element and consumed rows and no provided surface.
evidence: TSD S7 T-A.1 and T-A.2 (two POST operations, error sets as codes), T4 (25 printed rows, 27 states), T5.1 (None), T3.1 (DF-FIN-010 to DF-FIN-020); FSD S7 A2.9 and A2.4.3.2 field catalog; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 R-WO-05; context pack ownership rows (two POST operations, EV-24, JOB-16) and connection-matrix row S7; legacy RWB-E6-021 Data (v_ace_account DF-ACE-001 to -042, v_ace_npa_asset DF-ACE-208 to -219, interaction DF-INT-001 to -013)
area: S7 rwb-writeoff, posting feature FEAT-WOF-09, contract baseline
owner_role: Solution architect with the rwb-writeoff tech lead and the owners of rwb-source-data, rwb-case and rwb-decision
proposed: Publish the baseline with the four consumed rows and their placeholders, the state enumeration with the unprinted values marked, decision_log_id stated as the local record identifier, the prepared-posting-pack schema composed from the pack and the source-data answers, and an explicit record that no ALS or general-ledger element is declared because RWB-ITG-E6021-ITG owns the crossing.
